title: Redwire’s SpaceMD Announces its First Commercial Mission on SpaceX’s Starfall Spacecraft to Scale In-Space Pharmaceutical Development
summary: SpaceMD plans to fly 32 PIL-BOXes in 2028 on this Starfall mission JACKSONVILLE, Fla. (August 6, 2026) – Space Microgravity Development LLC (SpaceMD), a wholly owned subsidiary of Redwire Corporation…
body_text: SpaceMD plans to fly 32 PIL-BOXes in 2028 on this Starfall mission JACKSONVILLE, Fla. (August 6, 2026) – Space Microgravity Development LLC (SpaceMD), a wholly owned subsidiary of Redwire Corporation (NYSE:RDW) and venture company focused on leveraging the microgravity environment to create dynamic innovations, announced today that it has signed a contract for a Starfall mission. Starfall is SpaceX’s new spacecraft that enables affordable, routine access to a microgravity environment and provides unique opportunities for on-orbit manufacturing, scientific research, and testing. The agreement creates a scalable new pathway for Redwire to continue expanding its commercial pharmaceutical research and manufacturing business to serve a growing customer base. SpaceMD’s first Starfall mission is planned for launch in 2028 and is expected to have the capacity to carry up to 32 of Redwire’s Pharmaceutical In-Space Laboratory (PIL-BOXes), making it the largest dedicated commercial microgravity research mission flown to date. Drug candidates selected through SpaceMD’s research initiatives will leverage the highly tailorable microgravity environment and mission duration provided by Starfall before returning to Earth for analysis, accelerating pharmaceutical development and other forms of commercial research. SpaceMD will develop a new variant of PIL-BOX, to contain and optimize research aboard the entire Starfall spacecraft, ensuring immediate value to pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology innovators, and academic researchers. This work builds upon hundreds of pharmaceutical and life sciences experiments and R&D that Redwire has flown and conducted on crewed systems from the Space Shuttle to the International Space Station (ISS). “Space-based pharmaceutical development is reaching an inflection point,” said John Vellinger, CEO of SpaceMD. “For decades, Redwire has built and operated the infrastructure that has enabled critical progress in microgravity research. Now, by combining our flight-proven microgravity payloads, such as PIL-BOX, with SpaceX’s innovative transportation capabilities, we’re dramatically expanding our ability to serve customers, increase research cadence, and accelerate the creation of life-changing therapies.” SpaceMD’s flight-proven PIL-BOX technology enables researchers to crystallize drug compounds in microgravity to develop improved formulations and new therapeutics. Since November 2023, 54 PIL-BOX systems have flown to the ISS, with 12 more being prepared for launch over September, October, and December of this year. SpaceMD has successfully crystallized 45 unique compounds, including insulin and molecules targeting cancer, cardiovascular disease, obesity, and diabetes. With the Starfall spacecraft, SpaceMD expects to significantly expand the scale and frequency of commercial microgravity research, accelerating scientific discovery and in-space pharmaceutical development. About SpaceMD SpaceMD is a subsidiary of Redwire Corporation focused on leveraging the microgravity environment of space to create new advances in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and other fields. SpaceMD utilizes innovative, flight-proven Redwire hardware to conduct this potentially life-enhancing work. SpaceMD uses the unique nature of space to benefit life on Earth. About Redwire Redwire Corporation (NYSE:RDW) is an integrated space and defense tech company focused on advanced technologies. We are building the future of aerospace infrastructure, autonomous systems, and multi-domain operations leveraging digital engineering and AI automation. Redwire’s approximately 1,400 employees located throughout North America and Europe are committed to delivering innovative space and airborne platforms transforming the future of multi-domain operations. For more information, please visit RDW.com. Media Contact: Tere Riley Tere.Riley@rdw.com OR Investors: Investorrelations@rdw.com

title: Lead Conversion Rate: What It Means, How To Measure It, And How To Improve It
summary: Everything you need to know about tracking, benchmarking, and improving lead conversion rate, and where AI voice agents make the biggest difference.
body_text: How to Calculate Lead Conversion Rate Lead Conversion Rate = (Converted Leads / Total Leads) x 100 For example, if a sales team receives 200 inbound leads in a month, and converts 40 leads into booked consultations, the lead-to-consultation conversion rate is 20%. In order to extract the most meaningful data, segment the conversion rates by: lead source (paid, organic, referral), channel (inbound call, form fill, chat), lead type (new, returning), and time period. Aggregate conversion rates can be extremely misleading if they are hiding drastic differences. Industry Benchmarks for Lead Conversion Rate The industry benchmarks for lead conversion rates vary significantly depending on the company's industry, channel, and definition. However, leads who actively respond (inbound leads) are likely to convert at a higher rate than cold outreached leads, but their rate decays very quickly as response time increases. MIT Sloan School of Management, with the help of InsideSales.com (now XANT) , analysed over 15,000 leads and the response efforts made by over 100 companies. This research concluded that leads contacted within the first 5 minutes were 21 times more likely to be qualified than those contacted within 30 minutes of inquiry. In fact, they found that the probability of making meaningful contact dropped more than 10x between the 5-minute and 10-minute mark. Despite this data, InsideSales.com's 2021 Lead Response Research which reviewed over 55 million sales activities on 5.7 million inbound leads, found that 57.1% of first call attempts occur after more than a week Only 0.1% of leads are ever engaged within the first 5 minutes of their initial inquiry, meaning that most businesses are leaving money on the table. How to Improve Lead Conversion Rate Respond faster There is a large amount of research to back up speed-to-lead's positive effect on conversion rates. Every minute that passes between a lead expressing interest and a sales rep making contact reduces the probability of conversion. If a company has a high volume of inbound leads but limited sales staff, it becomes a huge structural problem. Inbound lead conversion often relies on immediacy, which simply cannot be scaled through human agents alone. Qualify leads earlier, and more consistently The level of purchasing intent for leads entering the sales funnel is incredibly diverse, and not every lead that contacts the organization is ready to buy. When a company sends every single inbound lead directly to a top sales representative, their time is wasted. Potential high-intent inbound leads are being lost, as less intent inbound leads consume too much attention. Implementing a structure for leads to be qualified before being sent to sales is crucial. This can be done either with a sales development rep or with a sophisticated set of automated emails and phone calls that probe the lead for intent and fit. Reduce friction in hand-offs One of the most common conversion killers is a poor handoff from lead qualification to sales consultation.When leads have to repeat their situation, wait for a callback that doesn't come, or navigate a cumbersome scheduling process, many drop out before the conversation even starts. Streamlining the scheduling and handoff process, particularly for high-intent inbound leads directly improves conversion. How telli's AI Voice Agents Improve Lead Conversion Rate {{usecases}} telli's lead qualification use case and lead reactivation use case are specifically designed to eliminate speed and consistency problems all at once. AI voice agents immediately reach every inbound lead within seconds, without human oversight, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including evenings and weekends when many high-intent leads submit forms. This solves the speed to lead problems at scale for any business. Secondly, AI voice agents improve conversion rates through consistency and reliability. On every call, they ask the right questions to identify sales-qualified leads and guide prospects toward the next step. They can also schedule meetings directly, ensuring a smooth and warm handoff to sales representatives. Unlike human agents, well-trained AI voice agents don’t suffer from fatigue, low energy, or other performance inconsistencies, allowing them to maintain high-quality conversations and maximize sales opportunities on every interaction. For businesses with complex products or premium services, AI voice agents work best as the first-touch qualification layer: they reach the lead immediately, assess intent and fit, and either book a consultation or transfer to a human sales rep with context already captured. Customer Spotlight: KitchenAdvisor {{stats}} Germany's leading kitchen comparison portal, KitchenAdvisor , built their business on the premise that personal service will lead to the ultimate sale. When a potential customer registered interest on the website, a kitchen planning expert would call to schedule a consultation. As the company grew, it was impossible to contact every lead in the allotted time. Qualified prospects were being overlooked because sales had a backlog of follow-ups. After implementing telli's AI voice agents, KitchenAdvisor developed a two-tier system. One agent for business hours (calls leads immediately and can transfer live to a planner), and an after-hours agent (reaches leads the same day before 9:30 PM and books future consultations) Both AI voice agents integrate directly with their Salesforce system and booking tool. As a result, the conversion rate between the consultation and the sale increased by 15%, response time decreased by 100%, and outreach success increased by 72% in four months. CEO, Richard Ruben, estimated that he added the capacity of 30% to his workforce, without the cost. {{testimonial}}

title: Paysafe Becomes Envision Racing Title Partner to Build the Future of Fan Engagement; Where Motorsport, Gaming and Payments Become One
body_text: Aug 14, 2026 New alliance will turn Formula E fans into participants, connecting race weekends, gaming and rewards through Paysafe's global payments network, with the team entering the new Gen4 era as Paysafe Envision Racing LONDON, UK – August 14, 2026 - Paysafe (NYSE: PSFE), a leading payments platform, today announced a title partnership with Envision Racing , one of Formula E's most successful and innovative teams, heralding a new era as Paysafe Envision Racing . Together, the two companies will power the future of connected fan experiences, uniting world-class motorsport, gaming and digital payments into the most engaging, rewarding and sustainable fan ecosystem in sport. The partnership is built on a simple idea: fans shouldn't have to choose between watching the action and being a part of it. From the grid to gaming, esports arenas to exclusive rewards, Paysafe and Envision Racing will create one connected journey where every interaction brings fans closer to the team and unlocks something new. Formula E is one of the fastest-growing motorsport properties in the world, built around exactly the audience Paysafe serves: digitally native fans who move fluidly between live sport, gaming, creator content and digital commerce. With the Gen4 era set to redefine electric racing through faster cars, greater performance and an even more compelling spectacle, Formula E is entering its most transformative chapter yet. Through Formula E's global stage, Paysafe will put Skrill , PaysafeCard , PaysafeWallet , PagoEfectivo , and its full portfolio of consumer payment brands in front of over 560 million TV viewers across the globe; as the infrastructure powering how they play, compete and connect. That ambition is backed by three decades of experience built for exactly this moment. Paysafe brings expertise in gaming and digital entertainment payments, a network of more than 1 million retailers, 19 million annual active users, regulatory and risk infrastructure spanning over 100 countries, and more than 100 banking partners worldwide. Few companies can combine that scale of trust with the speed this partnership demands. Under the partnership, Paysafe and Envision Racing will explore a shared roadmap of fan-first innovations; esports tournaments, sim-racing competitions, exclusive VIP race experiences, gaming activations, digital wallet integrations and rewards programs, all designed around a single ambition: turning spectators into participants. Bruce Lowthers, CEO of Paysafe said: "Envision Racing gives us a stage to reach a global audience that lives at the intersection of sport, gaming and technology, and that's exactly where Paysafe is built to play. This partnership will build something fans haven't seen before; one ecosystem where racing, gaming and rewards come together, and where Skrill, PaysafeCard, PaysafeWallet and PagoEfectivo become part of how a new generation of fans engage with the sport they love. We’re proud to partner with a team that shares our passion for innovation and redefining what’s possible for fans.” Franz Jung, CEO & Chairman of the Board of Envision Racing and VP Envision Energy said: Envision Energy is delighted to have such a wonderful global brand like Paysafe joining Envision as Title Partners of the team. We’re really excited to see where the two businesses can drive this racing team. We’re incredibly proud of our achievements on and off track and we know that Paysafe will be supporting us in the next evolution as we enter GEN4.” Sylvain Filippi, Managing Director and CTO of Envision Racing, said : “Paysafe joining us as Title Partner is a huge moment for the team. They’re a genuine global player with a presence across gaming, entertainment, and payments that aligns closely with Formula E’s global fanbase. We are building the foundations of a very successful fan programme - we are going to enjoy our journey with Paysafe to bring our unique positioning in sport to more people globally and to continue driving awareness and understanding in how this team is committed to supporting a healthier planet. We’ve got some brilliant plans in motion together, and the start of Season 13 in the new GEN4 car is just the beginning.” The partnership launch will be marked with a series of activations across the London E-Prix on August 15–16 and beyond, with a livery launch expected in October and larger activations across Season 13. About Paysafe Paysafe is a global payments platform powering the experience economy, with a strong focus on the iGaming, video gaming, e-commerce, online trading, retail, travel and hospitality sectors. With 30 years of expertise in payment technology, Paysafe helps businesses and consumers lift every experience through seamless, secure payment solutions, including card payments, digital wallets such as Skrill, eCash solutions like PaysafeCard, and a suite of local payment methods. With approximately 2,800 employees across 12 countries and annualized transactional volume of $167 billion in 2025, Paysafe connects people and businesses worldwide through innovative digital payment experiences. About Envision Racing Envision Racing is one of the founding and most successful teams in the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship and the 2022/2023 Formula E Teams’ World Champions. Owned by Envision, the team has sustainability embedded in its DNA and was created with one simple purpose: to accelerate the transition to green technologies to secure a sustainable future. Both on and off the track, Envision Racing uses the global platform of Formula E to accelerate innovation and inspire positive climate action. Through its Race Against Climate Change™ programme - including initiatives such as Sustainable Chain - the team mobilises fans, partners and communities around the world to take meaningful action for people and planet. For more information, visit www.envision-racing.com About Envision Envision is the world’s leading green technology company, and a global leader in future energy systems. With the mission of “solving challenges for humanity’s sustainable future” and the vision “to create a new prosperity for civilization,” Envision has pioneered the AI power system and is committed to building a sustainable, intelligent and inexpensive energy foundation. Envision’s portfolio includes Envision Energy, an energy system company specializing in smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions; and Envision AESC, a global leader in the development and manufacturing of high-performance batteries. Envision continues to drive wind power and energy storage to become the “new coal,” and power batteries, green hydrogen, green ammonia, green methanol, and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) to become the “new oil,” while building a renewable energy-based “new grid” powered by physical AI. Envision operates across China, Germany, France, the UK, Spain, Denmark, the UAE, India, Vietnam, Indonesia, Australia, the US, Japan, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile. It has established over 30 R&D and operations centers, along with more than 100 manufacturing bases worldwide. Envision was named one of MIT Technology Review’s “2025 Climate Tech Companies to Watch” and honored with “AI for Sustainability Excellence” at Reuters Global Sustainability Awards 2025. It was also recognized as a “Green Giant” in 2024 “TIME 100 Most Influential Companies” list, and as an “Energy Innovator” in Fortune’s 2024 “Change the World” list for its major innovations in net zero industrial parks and full-stack green hydrogen technology, marking its second appearance one the list following its inclusion in 2021. title: How to Choose a Gaming PC: Specs That Matter Most for the Best Buy
summary: Learn which gaming PC specs matter most—GPU, CPU, RAM, storage, cooling, and PSU—so you can buy the right rig for your budget.
body_text: Shopping for a gaming PC shouldn’t feel like decoding a spec sheet in another language. The trick is knowing which parts actually affect your gameplay and which ones just sound impressive in a product title. For most shoppers, a smart buy comes down to a few key components: the graphics card, processor, memory, storage, cooling, and power supply. Get those right, and it becomes much easier to compare desktops with confidence. Whether you’re chasing high-refresh competitive play or looking for a rig that can handle the latest AAA games, the best gaming PC is the one that matches your monitor, your favorite titles, and your budget. Here’s how to shop smarter and focus on the specs that really matter. 1. Start with your gaming needs Before you compare hardware, think about what you actually play and what display you’re using. A PC built for Valorant or Counter-Strike has very different needs than one meant for Cyberpunk 2077, Alan Wake 2, or 4K single-player gaming. Your monitor matters, too. 1080p at high refresh rates is a very different target than 1440p or 4K. As a rule, the higher the resolution and refresh rate, the more the GPU should take priority. If you’re mostly after smooth competitive gaming, a balanced midrange CPU and GPU is often the best value. If you want max settings, ray tracing, or more room for future upgrades, it makes sense to put more of the budget into graphics and cooling. 2. Focus first on the graphics card For most gaming PCs, the GPU is the star of the show. It has the biggest impact on frame rate, visual quality, and how well a system handles modern features like ray tracing and upscaling. When you compare desktops, make sure you look at the exact GPU model instead of generic marketing terms like “gaming graphics.” A few details matter most: how much video memory it has, whether it supports features like DLSS or FSR, and whether it lines up with your target resolution. For example, an 8 GB GPU can make sense for 1080p gaming, while 12 GB or more is usually the safer choice for 1440p and higher settings. 3. Choose a CPU that will not bottleneck the system The processor still plays an important role, especially for high-refresh-rate gaming, simulation games, open-world titles, and streaming or recording while you play. A powerful GPU paired with a weak CPU can lead to uneven performance, stutter, or lower minimum frame rates. For many buyers, a modern 6-core or 8-core CPU hits the sweet spot. Look for current-generation chips with strong boost clocks and solid single-thread performance. You usually do not need the most expensive processor unless you also plan to do heavy content creation or want to push very high frame rates in CPU-sensitive games. 4. Do not ignore memory and storage RAM affects how smoothly your system handles multitasking and some newer games. Today, 16 GB is the practical minimum for gaming, while 32 GB is the better pick if you like to keep lots of apps open or want more long-term flexibility. It is also worth checking whether the system uses DDR4 or DDR5, since DDR5 platforms generally offer more headroom on newer builds. Storage makes a big difference in everyday use. A PCIe NVMe SSD offers much faster load times than older hard drives or SATA SSDs. For a gaming PC, 1 TB is a comfortable starting point, especially since many modern games can take up well over 100 GB each. If you plan to install a large library, 2 TB is often the better value. 5. Verify cooling, power supply, and upgrade path Good cooling helps your system hold boost performance and can keep noise levels down, too. Look for strong case airflow, large fans, and a CPU cooler that matches the processor’s heat output. If the PC uses a more powerful GPU, the case should also have enough ventilation to help avoid thermal throttling. The power supply should come from a reputable brand and provide enough wattage with some overhead. If future upgrades matter to you, check the motherboard and case layout as well. Easy access to extra M.2 slots, RAM slots, and GPU clearance can help the system stay useful for longer. 6. Final buying checklist When you are comparing gaming PCs, use this order: GPU first, CPU second, then RAM, SSD, cooling, and power supply. That approach helps you avoid overspending on a strong processor while the graphics card holds the system back. It also makes prebuilt PCs easier to compare, because the best value usually comes from balanced parts instead of one big headline spec. Match the GPU to your resolution and refresh rate Choose at least 16 GB of RAM, with 32 GB for heavier use Prefer a PCIe NVMe SSD over a hard drive-based configuration Check cooling, airflow, and PSU quality before buying Look for a balanced build rather than one oversized component Bottom line: the best gaming PC is the one that fits your games, your monitor, and your budget. If you start with the GPU, make sure the CPU can keep up, and then check memory, storage, and cooling, you’ll be in a much better position to choose a system that feels worth it on day one and beyond. Frequently Asked Questions What GPU is best for 1080p gaming? A midrange GPU is usually the best value for 1080p gaming because it can deliver strong frame rates without pushing the price too high. If you mainly play esports titles, you can often choose a less expensive card than someone who wants high settings in demanding AAA games. How much RAM do I need for a gaming PC? 16 GB is the practical minimum for modern gaming and should handle most current titles well. If you stream, multitask heavily, or want more future-proofing, 32 GB is the safer long-term choice. Is the CPU or GPU more important for gaming performance? For most gaming PCs, the GPU has the biggest impact on frame rate and visual quality. The CPU still matters for high-refresh gaming, simulation games, and preventing bottlenecks, so a balanced build is usually the smartest buy. What kind of storage should I look for? A PCIe NVMe SSD is the best option for faster boot times and shorter game load screens. A 1 TB drive is a solid starting point, but 2 TB is often the better value if you plan to keep a large game library installed. What should I check before buying a prebuilt gaming PC? Confirm the exact GPU, CPU, RAM, storage type, cooling, and power supply instead of relying on the headline product name. It is also smart to review the warranty, airflow, and upgrade options so the system remains a better value over time. The report confirms that “global tax functions are at an inflection point” and supports this thesis with survey responses from “the people who set budgets, approve technology roadmaps, and answer to boards” – the organizational leaders responsible for financial management, tax management, and IT, along with C-suite executives. title: Exam Anxiety: Coping Tips for Students — Talkspace
summary: Learn how to cope with exam anxiety using effective study habits, calming techniques, stress management strategies, and mental health support for students.
body_text: Key Takeaways Exam anxiety involves emotional, physiological, and behavioral reactions tied to the possibility of negative evaluation and can affect learning during preparation, not just performance on test day. Recognizing the physical, emotional, and cognitive signs of exam anxiety early can help students and the people who support them respond before stress becomes overwhelming. Evidence-informed strategies, such as spaced practice, sleep, deep breathing, and progressive muscle relaxation, may help students manage academic pressure and mental health challenges more effectively. You studied and prepared, but when the test appears in front of you, everything suddenly goes blank. That moment of emptiness, the racing heart, and rising panic is exam anxiety, and it goes beyond simple pre-test nerves. For many students, it gets in the way of showing what they actually know. According to meta-analysis published in the Frontiers in Psychology , exam anxiety refers to the emotional, physiological, and behavioral reactions tied to the possibility of negative evaluation in an upcoming test or exam. Not all anxieties are the same. Anxiety can be a normal stress reaction, and mild levels of anxiety can actually help sharpen focus before a challenge. The true challenge arises when those reactions grow intense enough to interfere with schoolwork and daily life. Common Signs of Exam Anxiety Exam anxiety doesn't look the same for everyone, but knowing what to watch for is the first step toward managing it. The warning signs of test anxiety tend to show up across three areas: Physical symptoms Bodies often react to test-related stress before the mind fully registers what's happening. Common physical signs of exam anxiety include: Rapid heartbeat Sweating Muscle tension Restlessness or feeling physically on edge Urges to leave the situation Emotional symptoms According to a study published in Medical Education Online , the emotional layer of exam anxiety can feel just as disruptive as any physical symptom. Common emotional symptoms include: Excessive worry about outcomes Dread in the days or hours before a test Feelings of helplessness or panic Irrational fears Cognitive symptoms Test anxiety often involves worry and task-irrelevant thoughts, especially the persistent fear of not being able to recall what you studied. When these mental barriers take over during an exam, they typically manifest as: Racing thoughts that disrupt focus Difficulty concentrating on questions Mental blanks mid-exam Negative self-talk that damages confidence Together, these signs paint a fuller picture of how exam anxiety can show up and why it's worth taking seriously. Anxiety becomes a concern when it feels out of control and gets in the way of everyday things like school or work. Recognizing which of the above signs feels familiar is a meaningful first step toward finding the right kind of support. "Academics is a catalyst for multiple pressures to hibernate and for everyone they represent the past and the future. And so, there is a lot riding on the outcome. For students who have a lot going on personally, whether relational or environmental stress, it can sometimes be the one thing a student can control in life. For another student, it can be a vehicle for a future unimagined or un-promised. Either way, the end result can be an experience comingled with a ton of emotion. Remembering the fundamental truth that academics are not everything, can be a wonderful mantra for keeping the stress and anxiety manageable. And with that, harnessing your core values can allow you to stay connected to the learning process versus the strive for perfection." -Talkspace Therapist, Elizabeth Keohan, LCSW-C Understanding How Academic Pressure Triggers Anxiety Academic environments don’t just measure what students know; they repeatedly signal that performance carries real consequences. Pressure can accumulate in ways that shift anxiety from a passing feeling into a persistent pattern. Common anxiety triggers , such as fear of failure, peer comparison, and expectations from family or academic institutions, can heighten a student’s exam-related stress. When those pressures layer on top of one another, the cognitive demands of preparing for high-stakes exams can become genuinely overwhelming. Motivation vs. burnout: When pressure becomes harmful There's a meaningful difference between a challenge that energizes and pressure that depletes. Understanding how academic pressure affects students' motivation matters because the relationship isn't straightforward. According to a study published in Association for Psychological Science , 309 medical students preparing for a high-stakes exam found that higher trait test anxiety was associated with smaller gains in knowledge during the preparation phase. The study suggests that anxiety may not only affect performance in the exam room; it can get in the way of learning well before test day arrives. Below is a chart that outlines how pressure can affect people in either productive or harmful ways. Productive pressure Harmful pressure Creates focus and short-term motivation Interferes with studying and daily life Resolves after the stressor passes Persists and feels hard to control Accompanied by confidence in one's ability Accompanied by helplessness or dread Supports knowledge-building during prep May reduce knowledge gains during prep When pressure tips into the harmful column, it can affect how academic pressure affects students' motivation in lasting ways — making early, proactive support more useful than waiting until exam day. But, with the right approach, students can build habits that keep pressure from tipping into overwhelm. "Students these days juggle multiple responsibilities and these days students will not only say it but often show it. Without a doubt, academic fatigue is so individual but often observable in issues with sleep, deteriorating self-care, poor concentration, and sometimes pulling away from friends. If you notice unfamiliar overwhelm in a friend or fellow student, check in with them. You never know how the most benign check in, "How are you lately? You seem a bit tired," can be the most inviting validation someone just might need and crave especially if family or other usual supports, are inaccessible for a time. Suggesting professional support or counsel is also always worth a mention when a friend becomes stress saturated." - Talkspace Therapist, Elizabeth Keohan, LCSW-C Smarter Study Strategies to Prevent Last-Minute Stress Preparation that builds real knowledge tends to reduce the uncertainty that feeds test anxiety. The goal is not to study harder, but to study in ways that help you remember better. Build a realistic study timeline Breaking material into smaller chunks spread across available time is more effective than cramming everything in at once. Spaced practice consistently outperforms last-minute studying when it comes to actual learning outcomes. Working backwards from the exam date to build a realistic schedule is one practical way to put this into action. Active recall and spaced practice Repeatedly testing yourself on material, rather than passively re-reading notes, is one of the most effective ways to improve retention. Methods like self-quizzing, practice problems, and flashcards build real understanding, and that kind of preparation is what helps manage academic pressure with confidence. Lifestyle basics: Sleep, nutrition, and movement Getting 8 hours of sleep each night is essential for students of all ages. Good sleep sharpens focus and helps the brain retain information, both of which are key to studying effectively. What you eat can also have a real impact on your anxiety levels. A diet rich in fruits and vegetables, along with regular meals and nutrients like omega-3 fatty acids, probiotics, zinc, magnesium, and selenium, may help keep anxiety at bay. Exercise and movement can help reduce exam anxiety. Activities like aerobic workouts, yoga, and breathing exercises have all shown some benefit in managing stress. These lifestyle fundamentals work together, not as a checklist to complete perfectly, but as a foundation that makes everything else more manageable. Long-term habits lay the groundwork, but sometimes anxiety shows up mid-exam regardless of how well you've prepared. “Without question, connection and routine are foundational for mitigating academic stress. School is not just school these days. Students are managing myriad stressors in their lives all at once, including family, work, health and relationships. And without connection students can start to feel isolated - or, as it they are the only one walking in similar shoes buried by stress and worry in school. Staying connected in friendship circles can be an amazing place to land in order to diversify the academic lens. Prioritizing routine can also be a major win. That means, doing things regularly or frontloading, with health, sleep and nutrition, in order to feel grounded and ahead of cumulative stress. When connection and routine are identified as investments the return is less stress overall." -Talkspace Therapist, Elizabeth Keohan, LCSW-C In-The-Moment Techniques To Stay Calm During Exams Even well-prepared students can feel anxiety spike mid-test. Having a small set of familiar calming strategies can make a real difference. The 1-2-3 calming method Several forms of relaxation training, such as deep breathing exercises, progressive muscle relaxation, and autogenics, can help individuals reduce stress, enhance relaxation states, and improve overall well-being. Deep belly breathing : It involves diaphragmatic breathing as a simple relaxation method — breathing from the belly rather than the chest, letting the breath slow and deepen. Progressive muscle relaxation : It includes progressive relaxation as a technique of tensing and then releasing muscle groups in sequence, starting with one area and moving through the body. Positive self-talk : It can help promote positive psychological states and regulate cognitions. Emergency desk toolkit A few simple items can support in-the-moment calming during an exam. They're practical, low-effort options worth having available. For instance: Water to stay hydrated Earplugs to reduce sensory distraction A cue card with a breathing reminder A stress ball for physical tension release Mints or essential oils to help ground your senses The answer to the question of how to overcome exam anxiety in the moment often comes down to having a plan that's already practiced. Familiarity with these techniques before test day is what makes them useful when anxiety shows up uninvited. For most students, a combination of preparation, lifestyle habits, and in-the-moment strategies is enough to manage exam anxiety effectively. But sometimes, the support needed goes beyond what you can do on your own. Manage Exam Anxiety With Flexible Online Therapy From Talkspace For some students, test anxiety goes beyond test-day nerves and signals that academic pressure and mental health deserve more sustained attention. When anxiety feels overwhelming or consistently gets in the way of everyday life, connecting with a licensed therapist is a reasonable next step. Talkspace connects students with licensed therapists through message-based therapy, live video sessions, or audio sessions, all accessible from your device. For students managing academic stress alongside everything else, flexible access to care can lower the barrier to getting support. If you're ready to take that next step, get started with online therapy at Talkspace today. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) How does academic pressure affect students' motivation over time? Academic pressure can initially boost motivation by pushing students to achieve goals, but over time, excessive pressure often leads to stress, burnout, and decreased engagement. Prolonged high pressure can make students feel overwhelmed, reducing their intrinsic motivation and willingness to learn. What is the difference between normal stress and exam anxiety? Normal stress is temporary and can actually push you to prepare better. Exam anxiety is more intense, and it interferes with your focus, sleep, or performance even when you're well-prepared. How can students cope with exam anxiety without cramming? Students can manage anxiety by sticking to a study schedule, taking regular breaks, and practicing deep breathing or mindfulness. Getting enough sleep and staying active also helps keep stress levels in check. Can academic pressure and mental health issues be connected? Yes. Ongoing academic pressure can contribute to anxiety, depression, and burnout in students. When stress becomes constant and unmanaged, it can seriously affect emotional well-being. When should students seek help for exam anxiety? Students should seek help when anxiety feels out of control or starts affecting their sleep, eating, or daily life.
